title: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report — US crude, gasoline and distillate stocks (10:30 ET, the day before ISM Manufacturing)
source: EST: eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/schedule.php, fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200) — the page states the summary files are released 'after 10:30 a.m. eastern time' on Wednesdays, and its 2026 Holiday Release Schedule table lists exceptions only for the weeks displaced by Labor Day (delayed to Thursday 2026-09-10 at 12:00 ET) and Columbus Day (delayed to Thursday 2026-10-15 at 12:00 ET), i.e. NO exception falls between them. 2026-09-30 is a Wednesday, so the standard rule applies unmodified. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of them date doubt: the date is derived from the publisher's own stated cadence plus weekday arithmetic rather than read off a dated schedule row, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the same reasoning shape proposals/eia-weekly-petroleum-status-2026-09-16.from-fomc-2026-09-16.json recorded on 2026-09-10. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: DISCOVERED IN THE ism-manufacturing-2026-10-01 D-16 ADJACENCY SWEEP (2026-09-15). Proposed for an ATTRIBUTION reason, not a policy one, and the reason is specific to this week: the ISM Manufacturing print on 2026-10-01 has exactly one live claim attached to it — that the Iran/Gulf supply shock reaches its Prices Index (FT-ism-manufacturing-2026-10-01-1, Prices >= 73.0) — and this is the last weekly US inventory read published before that print, 10:30 ET the morning before. The calendar tracks the monthly oil reports around the corridor (eia-steo-2026-10-06, opec-jmmc-68th-2026-10-04, opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04) and one weekly instance proposed by the FOMC lane for 09-16, but not the weekly that lands inside this corridor. The tape it lands on is already crowded: 09-30 carries PCE, the third estimate of Q2 GDP, Chicago PMI, ADP, MU's print and a G20 trade ministerial, which is precisely why a crude or distillate build/draw published that morning is an attribution hazard for any 09-30 energy-complex move that a 10-01 ISM Prices post-mortem might otherwise credit to the shock. Context at proposal: WTI 104.75 and Brent 108.47 (09-15 closes), +25.6% on WTI since 08-28, 16.36 dollars of Nov-to-Mar backwardation, Hormuz traffic around 10 ships a day, Saudi Arabia's 7 mb/d East-West pipeline shut after strikes from Iraqi territory and Saudi output at its lowest since 1990. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is tiered low deliberately: no house playbook is energy-keyed, no tracked symbol carries direct crude exposure, and an ordinary weekly inventory print is inert tape. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Full ledger: docs/research/events/ism-manufacturing-2026-10-01.md.
